items.text: Entrepreneurial skills are the practical abilities that help you start and run a small venture: finding a real customer problem, selling, handling money, making decisions with incomplete information and keeping going after setbacks, and each can be practised on a tiny scale before you take on risk.
Check current official requirements and avoid schemes that ask for a fee to start.
high income opportunities come from finished work in one lane.
